opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; applications are not accepted from individuals unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts, culture, humanities, science, education, sport and other fields, supporting festivals, exchanges, collaborative projects, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year (up to £30,000 total for multi‑year projects)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; open to practitioners, managers, carers and others in health‑related fields, with preference for those new to UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare, with funding for travel, conference and publication costs.
